## What and why

## Kind of change (pick one; see "Which label?" in docs/testing.md)

- [ ] New feature of significant size: add the `big-feature` label (it starts a Windows build when merged)
- [ ] New feature, small
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Adjustment to an existing feature

## Checks

- [ ] Patch note added in `docs/patch_notes.d/` (if a player will notice it)
- [ ] New tests are in the right list (`tests/ci_manifest.txt` + `tests/ci_scopes.txt`, `ci_quests.txt` or `ci_nightly.txt`)
- [ ] UX checklist of the `ux-ui` skill ticked (UI changes)
